result:
The decisive mistake was WebSurfer's choice of source at step 8. The Orchestrator asked it to open "the IMDb page about Daniel Craig movies." WebSurfer opened the second search result, an old user-made list ("Daniel Craig Movies" by luisbrincos, modified 6 years ago). That list has only 19 titles and omits his recent films, including Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. The first result, "All Daniel Craig Movies Ranked," started with Knives Out and would have included them.

Every later availability check was run on that incomplete list, so the Orchestrator concluded Casino Royale, and Glass Onion was never considered.

AGENT: WebSurfer
STEP: 8
